version.philosophy: Rules that hold for every procedure are stated once, versioned, and read once per session, instead of being copied into every procedure that needs them.
version.method: Read this version once per session and apply its rules to every procedure version that references it.
version.goal: State the universal rules an agent follows whenever it applies a procedure.

contract.applies_to: Every procedure version that references agent.guidance.shared, pinned to this version, as a required reference. That version's own contract wins where it is stricter.

rules.rule: Work on one exact target: the repository, the full commit (git rev-parse HEAD), the working-tree state (git status --porcelain) and the environment. Another commit, even with an identical tree, is another target.
If the commit, the working tree, the inputs or the environment change during the work, stop and establish the target again.
Decide each conditional reference from its condition before running anything, and keep a one-line rationale for the decision.
Report a result only for the target and the commands that actually ran. A narrower scope never stands for the full gate.
Following a procedure verifies nothing by itself. Claim a target verified only with evidence from the verification system that checked that exact target.
Keep evidence concise: each command, its exit status and a short deterministic excerpt. Never paste whole logs.

Before changing anything after a failure, classify it. A product defect, an environment problem or a transient failure is handled where it belongs and is not procedural knowledge. Incorrect applicability, a missing precondition, an incorrect instruction, an inadequate verification criterion or an improved method is reported as feedback on the procedure version followed. Never revise a procedure because some command failed.
Do not merge, push, publish, release or close work items unless the procedure being followed says so.

steps.action: Treat each rule as a precondition and boundary of the procedure you follow, in addition to that procedure's own contract.

version.revision_reason: Knowledge-first representative example (#131, ADR-0043): the universal rules that dev.change.verify v4 repeats inline, stated once.
